code_pin_drift_declared_historical.reason: Timings measured before the same ruff reformat. They were deliberately NOT re-measured: re-running a wall-clock sweep to chase a formatting-only hash change spends hours to move no number. The behaviour-preservation evidence is the equivalence re-run above.

Measured before ruff reformatted identity.py (import ordering and a noqa directive). The equivalence phase was re-executed at the same seed against the reformatted module and reproduced its decisions exactly, which is what shows the reformat was behaviour-preserving.
